---
title: "Quizkit math-in-options demo"
---

This page's ONLY math lives inside quiz options, notes, kprim statements, and
feedback — used to verify MathJax still gets injected when the filter is the
sole source of Math nodes on the page.

::: {.quiz}

::: {.question}
Which value equals $\sqrt{5}$ rounded to two decimals?

- [ ] $2.00$

    Not quite — $2^2 = 4 \neq 5$.
- [x] $2.24$

    Correct: $\sqrt{5} \approx 2.236$, which rounds to $2.24$.
- [ ] $2.50$

::: {.feedback .correct}
Right — note that $(\sqrt{5})^2 = 5$ exactly.
:::

::: {.feedback .wrong}
Recall $\sqrt{5} \approx 2.236$.
:::
:::

::: {.question .kprim}
Rate each statement.

- [x] $\sqrt{4} = 2$.

    True since $2^2 = 4$.
- [ ] $\sqrt{-1}$ is a real number.

    False — $\sqrt{-1} = i$ is imaginary, not real.
:::

:::

## Shuffle + math example

::: {.quiz shuffle="true" shuffle-questions="true"}

::: {.question}
Which expression simplifies to $x^2$?

- [ ] $x \cdot 1$
- [x] $x \cdot x$

    Because $x \cdot x = x^{1+1} = x^2$.
- [ ] $x + x$
:::

::: {.question}
Which is the derivative of $x^2$?

- [ ] $x$
- [x] $2x$

    Since $\frac{d}{dx} x^2 = 2x$.
- [ ] $2$
:::

:::
